task_description: Make the SupplyHub (almoxarifado) inventory a SHARED/GLOBAL cloud inventory, offline-first, across the FastAPI backend (cloud_api/app) and the Flutter client (lib/features/supply_hub). All devices share ONE cloud inventory (add/edit/delete on one device is visible on others after sync); the cloud always holds the data; the app works fully offline with local Hive persistence across restarts and syncs up when network returns. Remove the per-device partitioning and the destructive sync/pull; keep the HTTP contract shape stable.
